summary.mission: read-only eval of owned ES vendor schema/quotes: schema doc, close conventions, spread-proxy recompute, honest capability statement
headline: Vendor ohlcv-1m ES is tick-clean on outrights (0/478,951 off-grid) and id-stable; spread combos on 0.05 grid are mixed in and must be filtered.

IBKR ES daily close == CME final settlement mark, exactly (96/96); it is a 15:00-CT-anchored administrative mark ~18 ticks (~$225/ct) from the 16:00 CT last trade - earlier 15/4-tick finding corroborated and root-caused.

S6_FRONT_SPREADS ES proxy (1 tick / $12.50 / p90 $50) reproduced exactly from IBKR raw; vendor trade-based analogue 2-4 ticks overstates spread-only cost; both bracket a ~1-tick effective-spread regime for tiering ONLY.
